title: Thin! lightweight!
text: Thin! lightweight!. It is so thin that it bends as you lift it. Pedastol base wont last once filled. I dont plan on lifting once filled/heavy. Only bought plastic so not a falling glass hazard to store bath mag salts in. Not worth $16+
